title: Independence for whom?
goal: I can explain who gained and who gained little from independence.
grammar: Aunque: equality in words and in practice

items: I can say what the constitutions promised and when slavery ended in Brazil.
I can say when slavery ended in several countries.
I can explain what happened to indigenous communal lands and to women.
I can say why historians discuss who benefited from independence.
I can use aunque to say that something happened in spite of a promise or a difficulty.
